caption: Each 2×2 feature map is multiplied by its gradient weight and the two are added cell by cell. The sum row is entirely positive, so ReLU leaves it unchanged and the heat map is 0.5, 2 in the top row and 2, 0.5 in the bottom row.

spec.title: Grad-CAM worked example: α₁ = 0.5, α₂ = 1.0
spec.aria: Two 2×2 feature maps A1 and A2 are scaled by weights 0.5 and 1.0 and added cell by cell to give the sum [[0.5,2],[2,0.5]]; every entry is positive, so ReLU leaves the map unchanged as the final Grad-CAM heat map.
